Overview

Bruges is a city in West Flanders with a population of 118,000. A fairy-tale medieval city of cobblestone streets, picturesque canals, and well-preserved architecture, often called the Venice of the North. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
